chapterId.description: MUST equal ctx.itemId — this chapter's own id, e.g. 'ch_02'.

shots.description: One entry per shot in THIS CHAPTER's chapter_shots.shots, in the SAME order. Every shot must appear, even with an empty characters[] array. Only this chapter's own shots — never another chapter's.

shotId.description: MUST match a shots[].id from THIS chapter's chapter_shots exactly.

characters.description: Every anchored/recurring character physically present in this shot and their current appearance state as of this shot. Empty if no recurring character is present.

appearance.description: FULL current wardrobe + props-held + condition (dirt/wet/wounds/hair) as of THIS shot — a complete, standalone description, not a diff against a prior shot or a prior chapter.

signature.description: Short, stable lowercase key for this exact appearance state, e.g. 'rip__bearded_rusty_gun'. MUST be the SAME key an earlier chapter used for this same visual state — a deterministic dedupe pass downstream keys on this field, and a drifted signature silently generates a redundant identity plate. Gated on the MATERIALITY BAR (see prompts/chapter_state.md): only TWO categories of change ever earn a new signature — CLOTHING (garments put on, taken off, or replaced; a whole garment soaked/coated across the entire figure) and BODY PHYSIQUE (an amputated limb, morphing into another being, a beard/hair change that alters the head/face's form). NOT for carried/held items regardless of size (a keg, a rifle, a lantern — presence, absence, or how they're held), pose/posture/action, expression, minor accessories, localized soiling, or a degree-of-degree fade on an already-changed condition (soaked→damp→drying is one signature). `appearance` itself is NEVER gated by this bar and stays full-fidelity regardless. No cap on the number of distinct signatures; this bar is about precision, not a ceiling.

changedThisShot.description: One short phrase naming the delta applied at this exact shot (e.g. 'grows long gray beard'), or the literal string 'none' if this shot carries the character's prior state (from earlier in this chapter, or folded forward from the previous chapter) forward unchanged.
